title: LOCUS: Causal Support Windows for Attribute Control in Autoregressive Image Generation
abstract: Unified autoregressive (AR) image generators struggle to satisfy multiple attribute constraints in a single prompt. Although these attributes are decodable from image-token latents, editing those latents at test time remains difficult. Adding a fixed attribute direction to the prefix can reinforce a requested attribute but rarely overrides a conflicting one, such as turning a car red when the prompt specifies blue. We investigate how the effect of an intervention depends on where it acts in the image-token sequence. We introduce the causal support profile, which measures, for each attribute, how often patching image-token states within a given window flips the rendered attribute. Structural attributes (count and position) are most responsive in early, narrow windows, while appearance attributes (color, size, and material) respond over later, broader windows. A budget-matched comparison of early and middle windows shows that the effect of window location depends on the target attribute, and two-dimensional support maps show that the responsive regions track spatial content. Based on these profiles, we propose LOCUS (Latent Optimization in Causal Support windows), which diagnoses which attribute failed and routes test-time latent optimization to its corresponding support window. With the generator, optimizer, reward, verifier, and token budget held fixed, support-routed windows outperform late windows by 23.6 percentage points in GenEval++ macro accuracy. With the generator frozen, LOCUS raises Janus-Pro's GenEval++ accuracy from 24.6% to 46.8% overall and from 19.5% to 40.5% on multi-attribute tags. On GenEval, LOCUS repairs 48.1% of failed generations in one rollout, compared with 37.4% for prefix optimization, and needs 14% fewer rounds on average to succeed.

analysis.sourceNote: 依据精确 arXiv 版本 2611.22867v1 的 17 页全文及关键页面核验；实验数字均为作者报告，未独立复现。
analysis.ideaZh: LOCUS离线测量哪些AR image-token窗口能改变属性，再把失败属性路由到对应latent optimization。作者报告Janus-Pro GenEval++ 24.6到46.8，但同预算prefix已有43.6，实际相对prefix增益3.2点；23.6点headline是对较弱late-window。可用于设计agent属性修复，跨模型证据目前主要是commit顺序。
analysis.motivationZh: AR图像生成中的属性虽可从latent解码，固定前缀干预仍难可靠修复计数、位置与外观等不同失败。
analysis.methodZh: 以只差一个属性的donor/receiver prompt做activation patching，计算属性flip rate随窗口位置的profile。count/position较早窄，color/size/material较后宽且随物体空间位置变化；运行时verifier诊断失败属性，取支持窗口并在16-token预算下REINFORCE latent optimization，再rollout与复检。generator weights不变。
methodFlow: 对minimal pairs执行cross-prompt activation patching，离线标定属性support profile。
合并对应support windows并按固定token预算选取latents。
REINFORCE更新选中latents，冻结generator及其他位置，重新生成并验证。
analysis.experimentsZh: Janus-Pro7B、576 raster image tokens；GenEval和GenEval++ 280 prompts/7tags；GPT4.1诊断和outer verify，Qwen3.5-9B重评同图。五种window arms均16 tokens。 作者报告GenEval++ macro base24.6、prefix43.6、random40.7、late23.2、LOCUS46.8%（Table3, PDF p.7）。 作者报告GenEval单rollout失败修复48.1% vs MILR37.4%，六rollouts77.1% vs74.8%，mean rounds2.17 vs2.53（Table4, Sec.4.4, PDF pp.7-8）。 作者报告multi-attribute accuracy19.5到40.5%；Qwen重评LOCUS58.2、prefix54.1（Table3, Sec.4.4, PDF p.7）。 控制Janus-Pro同图同budget强于跨模型排行榜；external generators仅引用reported score，非训练或计算匹配比较。未测diffusion或通用image-editing闭环迁移。 prefix/mid/late/random/support预算匹配，blind1464 prompt-window pairs，wrong donor/window controls，unified evaluator及held-out objects；其他模型仅prefix commit order。
analysis.insightZh: 将可读属性与可控制属性区分，并以窗口位置解释属性定向修复；latent optimizer为已有MILR，主要贡献是支持测量与路由。
analysis.evidenceZh: profile使用donor state patching的渲染属性flip rate，而非linear probe accuracy（Sec.3.1, Fig.2, PDF p.3）。oracle donor用于机制probe，线上repair不需要oracle image。 作者报告：结构与appearance的同预算early/mid-window反应不同，支持具有空间关联（Figs.5,7, Sec.3.2, PDF p.5）。interaction39个百分点，CI为1到78，10到12 clean pairs每属性，样本小。 作者报告：同optimizer、reward、verifier、budget下路由略优于prefix，明显优于late（Tables3-4, PDF p.7）。prefix43.6，late23.2，避免用23.6点替代对强baseline增益。
analysis.caveatZh: 部分机制只测layer0且样本小；appearance/structure使用不同CLIP/detector，unified VLM检查未完全去除评测混杂。 跨模型只测commit order，没有band或2D support；content gate阈值敏感性未量化。 profile固定离线属性集合，per-prompt估计未实现。 verifier兼诊断与评测，独立Qwen重评支持排序但不替代实体标注。 对prefix主增益为3.2点且不在每tag领先，不能称23.6点超越既有最佳latent optimization。 本轮未确认可公开使用的作者实现。
analysis.whyRelevantZh: 为visual design agent提供属性定向纠错的token位置与预算分配，减少盲目prefix优化。
